title: Enkaus
extract:
Enkaus is  Follie's signature beam rifle, hosing down its targets with a stream of  Corrosive ink. Its Alternate Fire launches a glob of ink that stains enemies, allowing follow-up primary fire to refund Enkaus ammo and instantly dissolving them when they hit a certain health threshold.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Corrosive damage.
This weapon does not use ammo pickups.
Alternate Fire consumes 15 ammo to launch an ink projectile that explodes in an 8 meter radius on contact with enemies or a surface. Enemies hit by the blast are covered with ink for 20 seconds. The projectile will also leave a puddle with a 8 meter radius, lasting for 10 seconds and staining enemies that come into contact with it.
When wielded by  Follie, the Alternate Fire applies Inkblot, Follie's passive.
Enemies afflicted by Inkblot are considered ink-stained targets, even if the Enkaus's alternate fire wasn't used.
Shooting ink-stained enemies with the primary fire draws ink back into the weapon, causing the Enkaus to consume no ammo and restore 0.33 ammo per hit for each enemy hit.
 Firestorm increases the area of the paint left on the ground.
Ink-stained enemies will be dissolved and instantly killed if Enkaus drops their health below 35%. Enemy health can be lowered by other sources before instakilling them with Enkaus.
Enemies with special states such as  Thrax Centurion or  Kuva Larvling will not be dissolved to avoid breaking their mechanics. Bosses cannot be instakilled.
AoE extra-hit sources (e.g.  Combustion Beam,  Blast procs) will trigger the instakill.
When wielded by  Garuda, while the enemy is inflicted with  Seeking Talons, the instakill damage element will change from  Corrosive to  Slash.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
Enkaus's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Follie's Hunt. Access requires completion of the Chains of Harrow Quest.
Alternatively, Enkaus's blueprints can be purchased from Aspirant Zorba in any Relay using  Atramentum earned from playing Follie's Hunt. Each component blueprint costs 400  Atramentum and the main blueprint costs an additional 1,200  Atramentum, totalling 2,400  Atramentum for a full set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Crafting

Notes
The execution damage at 35% on ink-stained enemies is done as a single hit with a base 600% critical chance, 1x critical multiplier, and guaranteed  Corrosive status equalling the value of remaining health on the enemy.
A few sources of critical chance and damage are able to affect this damage, namely:
 Arcane Crepuscular
 Biting Frost
 Grave Spirit

Tips
The execution damage can be spread to additional enemies via  Kullervo's  Collective Curse and  Uriel's Catenach.

Trivia
Rebecca Ford referred to the Enkaus as the "legally distinct Splatoon weapon" during Devstream 193.
The etymology of Enkaus might be rooted in Encaustic painting, an art form wherein pigment and hot wax are painted on a hard surface (such as stone). As the wax cools, it seals and protects the painting from the elements. Encaustic paintings were common in ancient Greece, Rome, and Ptolemaic Egypt.
